newsitem.title: USA: Deluxe Corp Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Deluxe Corp Q4 loss widens.

text.p: Q4 1996 results include pretax charge of $107.4 million, or $0.85/shr after tax, for goodwill impairment, restructuring, gains and losses on sales of business, other costs.

Q4 1995 results include $4.8 million or $0.06/shr loss from discontinued operations. Q4 1995 loss from continuing operations of $1.1 million or $0.01/shr also included pretax charge of $62.5 million related to production consolidation, elimination of unprofitable product lines and overhead, and other balance sheet adjustments.
Excluding items in both years and year-ago loss from discontinued operations, Q4 1996 operating profit $0.55 a share vs $0.46 in Q4 1995.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include pretax charges of $142.3 million or $1.10 a share for goodwill impairment, restructuring, gains and losses on sales of businesses, and other costs.
Full-year 1995 results include $7.4 million or $0.09 a share loss from discontinued operations. Income from continuing operations of $94.4 million or $1.15 a share included the $62.5 million charge.
Excluding all items for both years, full-year 1996 operating earnings $1.90 a share vs $1.62.
